summary: Frontend-only validation of the new Highlights page and updated About footprint section on A2Z Plant Nutrient Next.js site. All requested features verified end-to-end on desktop viewport (1920x1080) using the preview URL.
verified_features: Nav contains data-testid='nav-highlights' with href='/highlights' and clicking navigates to /highlights.

/highlights renders data-testid='highlights-page', hero 'Our Key Highlights' visible, highlights-grid renders exactly 20 cards (highlight-card-0 ... highlight-card-19), each card has an image, index label, category tag and title.
/about page footprint-section replaces the old 4-card stats section and renders the interactive India map (data-testid='india-map').
All 6 state-chip-{up,mp,or,dl,gj,rj} buttons and their corresponding map-state-{...} SVG paths are present.
Hovering a state chip highlights the matching map path (verified via fill=#047857 and drop-shadow on map-state-or after hovering state-chip-or; Odisha visibly darkened in screenshot).
Hovering a map-state path shows data-testid='map-tooltip' with state name and note (verified UP -> 'Uttar Pradesh — Home state — HQ in Varanasi...').

footprint-stats shows three cards with correct final values: '100+ Projects Delivered', '10 Lakh+ Sq. Ft. Transformed', '2021 Incorporated' (counter animates from 0; final values render correctly after ~3s).
critical_code_review_comments: Stat counters animate from 0 -> target. Snapshot tests that read text immediately on load will see '0+/0 Lakh+'. Consider adding a data attribute with the final value (e.g. data-final='100') for testability, or expose the final value in DOM alongside the animated one.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Highlights page and About footprint (India map + 3 stats) are fully working. Note that footprint-stats numbers are animated counters; wait ~3s after scrolling the section into view before asserting final text.
